mechanismMapping.meibu: At actual other-player PlayStarting, test owner within actor attack range; optionally pay one actual legal own HE discard and drain movement/HP/recovery observers. Grant exact current phase actor Zhixi until actual turn expiry. If actual paid card is neither Slash nor a black trick, set the directed actor-to-owner distance to one for this actual turn. The distance effect has no Fenxun ending debt. Paid source loss must not pay twice or revoke the already issued effect.
mechanismMapping.zhixi: Locked dynamic Use prohibition during the affected actual Play phase: after any trick use in that phase, or when actual phase use count reaches current HP. Text has no hand-material restriction, so physical/converted/virtual Use paths must obey it. Actual response-use Nullification counts as a trick use; pure played responses are not Use. This is a prohibition query, not a latched total-turn ban; phase instance and current HP must remain dynamic.
mechanismMapping.mumu: At own PlayStarting choose either actual other-owner equipment discard, or actual armor acquisition from any player equipment including self. No additional own HE payment and no discard-branch draw reward exist in this version. Only actual armor acquisition issues own actual-turn Slash Use and Response prohibition, with exact paid movement receipt and child drain.

verification.paidDonorDeathInterpretation: Inferred from the once-completed cost and absence of a donor-alive requirement in the current Meibu text: after real payment and its children, source loss or donor death does not revoke the grant to a living actual phase owner. A game already decided or a dead phase recipient drains without a new effect. The focused check exercises this interpretation through real commands; it is not a separate official FAQ quote.
verification.responseUseInterpretation: The official current Zhixi text says use rather than play. Existing engine typed native responses distinguish actual response-use Nullification/Dodge/Peach from a Duel played Slash and supplied cards; only actual uses count. Frozen effective card kind and the same true ActionId are appended to the existing phase ledger rather than inventing a use-ID sidecar.
